|game_text=Deploy on Sidious. While at Senate, if battle was just initiated anywhere, opponent must relocate this card to their participating non-droid character; during battle here, your destiny draws may not be canceled. If character about to be lost, relocate to Sidious; may ▲ any one card.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[An Enemy Of The Republic]] (version 2 of 4). The image here is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB5-15-An_Enemy_Of_The_Republic-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]; no published image shows this text). The current text is [[An Enemy Of The Republic (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source; differences that come only from a document's medium (icons written out in words on the card list, straight quotes, credit lines) are not changes.
* '''Original''' ([[An Enemy Of The Republic]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; slip [[:File:VB5-15-An_Enemy_Of_The_Republic.png]]): “Deploy on Sidious. While at Senate, if battle was just initiated anywhere, opponent must relocate this card to their participating character; during battle here, your destiny draws may not be canceled. The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “15” at bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): adds “non-droid” and changes “a card” to “any one card”: “Deploy on Sidious. While at Senate, if battle was just initiated anywhere, opponent must relocate this card to their participating non-droid character; during battle here, your destiny draws may not be canceled. If character about to be lost, relocate to Sidious; may ▲ any one card.” Shown on the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013), which writes the ▲ out as “take any one card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”<ref name="cl-1250_18-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>. The card list is a text page: no slip, picture or slip number, and icons are written out in words.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[An Enemy Of The Republic (Errata 2)]]): The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-D-anenemyoftherepublic-pre.gif]]) prints the original printed text again, word for word: “Deploy on Sidious. While at Senate, if battle was just initiated anywhere, opponent must relocate this card to their participating character; during battle here, your destiny draws may not be canceled. If character about to be lost, relocate to Sidious; may ▲ a card.” '''What changed:''' “their participating character” and “may ▲ a card” again, for the card list's “their participating non-droid character” and “may ▲ any one card”. The image is undated. The PC's image folder (Virtual5-Dark) lists the file, with every other file in it, as last modified on 25 February 2013<ref name="r6-Virtual5-Dark">[https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034650/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A Apache directory listing of Virtual5-Dark/large] (Internet Archive, captured 18 August 2019): every file in the folder last modified 25 February 2013; the captures of the image in 2018 and 2019 have the same bytes as the file on the wiki. Research note R6, 11 November 2026.</ref>; it is dated by that upload date, after the card list and before the Master List. The date is a bulk upload of the whole folder, so the image may have been made earlier, but the wiki orders versions by the date each document was published (Bill, 11 November 2026). It is a version of its own even though its words repeat an earlier text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version). The card image is the whole card, with the Decipher picture, and prints the slip number “15” at bottom right.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[An Enemy Of The Republic (Errata 3)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 22)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=22, page 22. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=22 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the original printed text again, word for word: “Deploy on Sidious. While at Senate, if battle was just initiated anywhere, opponent must relocate this card to their participating character; during battle here, your destiny draws may not be canceled. If character about to be lost, relocate to Sidious; may ▲ a card.” '''What changed:''' Nothing in the words: the Master List prints the same words as the card image. The Master List repeats words published earlier; it is a version of its own because it was published after a different text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). As the latest publication it is the current text. The PC website card list was generated from the Holotable card data; the Master List went back to the release-sheet words. The Master List slip shows the whole card frame with the picture area left blank; it prints no slip number at bottom right (the release-sheet slip has “15”). GEMP's current card plays this text: opponent may relocate it to any participating character, droids included (play change from the card-list text, approved by Bill, 11 November 2026).
